data.title: Unit 1 : The Human Body
Brain, Heart and Lungs
data.heading: The lungs
data.text: We breathe in oxygen from the air through our nose.
The oxygen reaches the lungs and then enters the blood.
The blood carries the oxygen to the heart and then from the heart to other parts of the body.
The blood carries carbon dioxide to the lungs that the body doesn't need.
Carbon dioxide is removed from the body when we breathe out.
